what: When the photo pile panel appears, only the photos currently on screen move to the exact center and stack up. They then switch on one by one every .1s in random stacking order and hold for 1s. After that each scatters to its own place with a random duration (.8~1.4s) and random order (×.01s) on cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1).

options.on: Start signal (document event name) — give the event the loader fires when done and it starts then, if none, it starts on attach
options.hold: Seconds from the start until scattering, not from when all are lit, default 1
options.each: Interval between lighting up one by one (s), default .1
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Photo slot (receives overlap order and on state)
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Image to move inside the cell (the cell itself if none) — leaves its own transform alone and pushes it with CSS translate

use: …
note: Do not touch cells outside the screen. If photo sizes are set late, the center shifts, so give cells and images a size (ratio) first

from.where: index.html .ov photo pile (original initializeOverviewItems — for cells inside the screen, --translate-x/y, random z-index and delay. Turned on at has--loaded with z × .1s, and at has--finished (1s later) .fs-media runs with (.6×rand + .8)s · delay × .01s · cubic(.77,0,.175,1))
